notes.subject: ol bilum bilong insait
notes.rationale: כליה em i bilum/kidni — Inglis 'reins' i tulait long en

notes.subject: long Yahwe
notes.rationale: ves i toktok stret long Yahwe (yu yet)

notes.subject: קנית
notes.rationale: ol i tok 'yu baim' o 'yu gat' — tasol 'wokim' i stret long stat bilong man

translation: Bihainem yu yet i wokim ⟨את⟩ ol bilum bilong insait bilong mi; yu kilim wanwan hap wantaim narapela long bel bilong mama bilong mi.
